Hi Samantha / VendorCorp onboarding team,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. To complete activation on our side procurement needs the following artifacts so we can route a PO and finish legal sign-off:

- Signed DPA (pdf)
- SOC 2 Type II report (or read-only link)
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV with vendor names, subprocess category, country)
- Primary billing contact and preferred invoice format (pdf or emailed invoice)

Can you also confirm if any data processing will be routed through APAC regions? We have a couple of customers that require explicit routing info.

Attachments: none yet; feel free to upload links or attach PDFs.

Ask: If you can get the DPA and subproc list into the thread by EOD Monday 2/23 that would keep us on schedule for a PO issue by Wed 2/25.

Thanks — I’ll loop procurement once we have the DPA and subproc list.

—Priyom
